notes.sowing: Start seed indoors 8 to 12 weeks before planting out, {cm:1.3} deep. Plant out from 2 weeks before to 1 week after your last frost, when seedlings are pencil thick, dropping each into a hole {cm:15} deep and watering it in.
notes.care: Leeks need a long season and steady moisture. Hill soil around the stems two or three times as they grow to lengthen the white shaft, keeping soil out of the leaf joints.
notes.harvest: Lift once stems are about {cm:2.5} across. Leeks stand frost, and hardy types can stay in the ground well into winter, dug as needed.
